Gate: `uv run --no-sync pytest` in this worktree over the four named files plus the six-file

state write after the declaration leaves the meta intact. The create-time refusal removes the stub
it created and the message carries the three questions. Answer to the fence's question: the
follow-on narrows the authoring surface but does not leave an author without a tool path.
